due_when.clears_when: A session that reads the board and reports 'no open MERGE SLOT CLAIM' can point to the evidence that its read reached the END -- a short page, or an empty probe past the last index -- and not merely to the page it happened to fetch. Concretely closeable by either: (a) both protocol surfaces carrying the short-page assertion AND a subsequent session's claim comment citing it (e.g. 'perPage=3 page=N returned 2 => tail'), or (b) a helper that establishes the end programmatically and is actually invoked by the merge preflight. Note what does NOT close this: adding a sentence telling sessions to 'be careful' or 'read the newest comments', which is what both docs already said while the violation happened.
